risks.summary: Release-critical workflow coverage remains incomplete.
risks.owner: Named workflow-family and phase owners; Phase 10/11 QA owner aggregates.
risks.deadline: Close each family gap in Phases 4-9 and leave no release-critical gap at Phase 11.
risks.required_work: Add the proportionate standalone, FreeCAD, GUI, persistence, output and performance evidence for each owned family.
risks.closure_evidence: Accepted family evidence plus complete Phase 10 and Phase 11 workflow matrices.

risks.summary: The B15 five-box chair body could be mistaken for final procedural geometry.
risks.owner: Phase 9 chair-definition owner; project owner accepts production geometry.
risks.deadline: Remove ambiguity before the Phase 9 chair exit or any production-chair claim.
risks.required_work: Keep the approximation labelled as legacy gap evidence and block it from production admission.
risks.closure_evidence: Accepted constituent-generation and geometry-oracle evidence.

risks.summary: Scan or CAD evidence could be mistaken for authoritative reusable geometry.
risks.owner: Phase 4 chair-schema and Phase 9 assimilation owners.
risks.deadline: Maintain the schema boundary through Phase 4 and prove it at the Phase 9 pilot.
risks.required_work: Separate retained evidence from canonical procedural definitions and reject ambiguous admission.
risks.closure_evidence: Fail-closed package tests and an accepted Phase 9 evidence-to-definition pilot.

risks.summary: Scans cannot establish nominal, hidden, worn or rail-fit geometry alone.
risks.owner: Phase 9 chair-evidence owner; project owner accepts unresolved values.
risks.deadline: Resolve or explicitly retain unknowns before Phase 9 production admission and recheck at Phase 11.
risks.required_work: Use independent evidence for nominal, hidden and rail-interface geometry.
risks.closure_evidence: Accepted Phase 9 source, residual and rail-fit evidence plus the Phase 11 audit.

risks.summary: Chair assimilation could add heavy or proprietary normal-runtime dependencies.
risks.owner: Phase 9 assimilation and Phase 10 packaging owners.
risks.deadline: Remove unsuitable runtime dependencies before Phase 9 acceptance and prove a clean Phase 10 install.
risks.required_work: Keep optional tooling outside normal runtime and validate clean package loading.
risks.closure_evidence: Phase 9 definition generation without source tooling and a clean Phase 10 Addon install.

risks.summary: Imported chair evidence could have unclear ownership, licence or permitted use.
risks.owner: Chair-package provenance owner; project owner accepts admission.
risks.deadline: Resolve rights before each package is admitted or published and re-audit at Phase 11.
risks.required_work: Record exact provenance, licence, intended use and dependency status.
risks.closure_evidence: Accepted package manifest and Phase 11 frozen-artifact rights audit.

risks.summary: Software licensing could be conflated with a blanket licence on generated output.
risks.owner: Licensing/provenance owner; project owner accepts output status.
risks.deadline: Maintain separation on every output-affecting change, prove Phase 9 propagation and re-audit at Phase 11.
risks.required_work: Classify software, data, media and output separately and fail closed on unresolved dependencies.
risks.closure_evidence: Validated output manifests and the Phase 11 lineage review.

risks.summary: A copied table or profile could be relabelled as isolated engineering facts.
risks.owner: Production-data/provenance owner; project owner accepts canonical admission.
risks.deadline: Remove copied or unresolved dependencies before Phase 9 project-cleared admission and at Phase 11.
risks.required_work: Classify every output-affecting field and replace unsupported collections.
risks.closure_evidence: Independently evidenced values plus clean Phase 9 and Phase 11 lineage audits.

risks.summary: A restricted or unknown dependency could reach an advertised production path.
risks.owner: Phase 6/9 export and output-rights owners; project owner accepts advertised use.
risks.deadline: Remove the route at Phase 6 for the selected seam, Phase 9 for all paths and prove absence at Phase 11.
risks.required_work: Propagate complete dependency status and refuse unsupported output clearance.
risks.closure_evidence: Clean selected-output, full-format and release-candidate lineage results.

risks.summary: Duplicate definitions or runtime patches could hide the live implementation.
risks.owner: Each extraction owner; Phase 10 integration owner owns final removal.
risks.deadline: Remove each duplicate at its retirement condition and all unowned production patches by Phase 10.
risks.required_work: Keep caller inventories and one authoritative implementation per shared concept.
risks.closure_evidence: Per-slice retirement records and Phase 10 absence of unowned production duplication.

risks.summary: Modularisation can increase source-file count without reducing runtime cost.
risks.owner: Architecture and migration-slice owners; Phase 10 integration owner consolidates.
risks.deadline: Tolerate bounded file growth through Phase 9; mitigate measured cost and remove speculative modules by Phase 10.
risks.required_work: Require cohesive boundaries and measure runtime effects separately from structure.
risks.closure_evidence: Per-slice structure/performance reviews and Phase 10 consolidation.

risks.summary: Governance can duplicate facts and grow stale.
risks.owner: Documentation-control and current phase owners; Phase 10/11 QA owner reviews.
risks.deadline: Apply the governance budget in Phase 4 and pass focused documentation audits at Phases 10 and 11.
risks.required_work: Use fixed live paths, one fact owner, frozen history, three-level task classification and CI-enforced consistency.
risks.closure_evidence: Passing current-path, change-level, link, progress and frozen-record checks with no routine historical rewrites.

risks.summary: Commands, history changes or disk failure could destroy unprotected project data.
risks.owner: Project owner owns independent backup; implementation/QA owner enforces safe work.
risks.deadline: Maintain the active cadence through every phase and repeat the frozen route at Phase 11.
risks.required_work: Preserve destructive-action controls, independent snapshots and restore drills.
risks.closure_evidence: Current backup records, cadence evidence and a successful Phase 11 recovery rehearsal.

risks.summary: Bounded Coin display, visibility, mouse-driven subelement selection and one application-command edit with Undo/Redo work; representative editing, persistence and resource evidence remain incomplete.
risks.owner: Phase 5 renderer owner; project owner accepts editing behaviour.
risks.deadline: Remove uncertainty through the real-GUI renderer decision before Phase 5 exit.
risks.required_work: Measure representative selection scale, editing, Undo/Redo, persistence and resource behaviour in real GUI workflows.
risks.closure_evidence: Accepted complete Phase 5 renderer decision record.

risks.summary: Deferred exact geometry could move rather than remove operator-visible cost.
risks.owner: Per-slice performance owners; Phase 10 integration owner freezes budgets.
risks.deadline: Measure at Phases 6-9, freeze budgets at Phase 10 and pass repeated Phase 11 qualification.
risks.required_work: Measure equivalent edit-only and edit-through-export workflows with parity checks.
risks.closure_evidence: Accepted reports, numerical budgets and repeated Phase 11 passes.

risks.summary: A cache signature could omit an output-affecting input and reuse stale results.
risks.owner: Domain/application owner for each signature; owning phase QA owner verifies.
risks.deadline: Prove each signed Phase 4-9 slice before exit and the complete matrix at Phase 11.
risks.required_work: Centralise complete signatures and test miss, reuse, change and change-back.
risks.closure_evidence: Per-slice invalidation evidence and the frozen Phase 11 signature matrix.

risks.summary: New persistence or migration could corrupt supported old documents.
risks.owner: Phase 4 compatibility/migration owner and later family owners; project owner accepts support.
risks.deadline: Bound the Phase 4 window, prove later families at Phases 7-9 and qualify clean upgrades at Phases 10/11.
risks.required_work: Keep versioned schemas, copied-target atomic migration, source preservation and fail-closed recovery.
risks.closure_evidence: Accepted per-family fixtures, operator lifecycle evidence and clean Phase 10/11 upgrades.

risks.summary: Legacy and modular comparison paths could become permanent duplication.
risks.owner: Named dual-path owners; Phase 10 integration owner owns final product-path removal.
risks.deadline: Remove later dual paths at their conditions and all unowned production duplication by Phase 10.
risks.required_work: Keep any retained oracle development-only with explicit ownership and rollback purpose.
risks.closure_evidence: Later retirement records and Phase 10 product import/caller proof.

risks.summary: The distributed Addon could drift from authoritative modular source.
risks.owner: Phase 10 packaging/build owner and Phase 11 release owner.
risks.deadline: Establish reproducible assembly at Phase 10 and reproduce it twice at Phase 11.
risks.required_work: Build from authoritative source and compare clean artifacts, installs and upgrades.
risks.closure_evidence: Phase 10 source/artifact parity and two matching Phase 11 builds.

risks.summary: Feature work could destabilise or silently expand the migration.
risks.owner: Project owner owns release scope; current phase owner triages changes.
risks.deadline: Maintain bounded tranches, freeze features at Phase 10 and allow only blockers at Phase 11.
risks.required_work: Classify scope before implementation and defer unrelated feature additions.
risks.closure_evidence: Bounded diffs, Phase 10 feature freeze and Phase 11 blocker-only record.

risks.summary: Reference-source provenance or licence could become ambiguous.
risks.owner: Licensing/provenance owner; project owner accepts source/publication evidence.
risks.deadline: Review every source change, re-audit at Phase 9 and verify the frozen Phase 11 artifact.
risks.required_work: Preserve source URL, checksum, archive decision, licence and notices.
risks.closure_evidence: Passing provenance controls and Phase 9/11 frozen-lineage audits.

risks.summary: A true authority transfer could occur without structured safety/risk challenge.

risks.required_work: Keep Level 1 and Level 2 work out of panels; record evidence, dissent, recommendation and decision for every Level 3 gate.
risks.closure_evidence: Linked panel and owner-decision records for every Level 3 authority or release transfer.
